# NBAPI 1.4.0

## Security

- Fixed quota overflow hardening for billing calculations by using bounded quota conversions instead of direct `float64` or `decimal.Decimal` to `int` casts.
- Added request limits for image `n`, task `duration` / `durationSeconds`, and OpenAI-compatible token limit fields.
- Rejected unexpected negative quota settlement paths so malformed calculations cannot be converted into user quota credits.

## Compatibility

- Preserved `/v3` base URL routing for Moonshot/Kimi Responses and model-list fetches.
- Ensured Moonshot Responses requests reuse the existing OpenAI-compatible conversion flow.
